cardOverview.overviewText: A premium Celesta card from IndusInd delivering luxury travel privileges, concierge services, milestone rewards, and lifestyle perks for affluent customers.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy B1G1 on movie tickets, capped at ₹700, and a flat 20% off on event and movie bookings on BookMyShow, with up to 3 free movie tickets per month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Get ₹3,000 off on dining throughout the year with the Sumptuous Beginnings program, available once every six months, limited to one coupon per transaction.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the dining partner’s app or website with your registered account. Browse exclusive dining and order-in offers, pick your favorite restaurants or dishes, and apply the offer at checkout. Pay with your IndusInd Celesta credit card to unlock special discounts and rewards.
